After the words दय 'to give', 'to go' and 'to protect', अय 'to go'and आस 'to sit', there is the affix आम् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

Terms: आम्

In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the word दायद् as its second member, the first member denoting inheritance preserves its original accent.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

दिगि is substituted for दे (दयते) in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

Terms: Some substitution
